channel.title: Paprika engineering blog
channel.description: Engineering notes on Kubernetes delivery, observability and dashboard design.

item.title: Kubernetes release dashboards: the signals that matter before and after a rollout
item.description: Choose useful Kubernetes release dashboard signals: revision identity, workload health, desired-state drift, Prometheus metrics and evidence freshness.

item.description: Write defensible PromQL for dashboards: distinguish counters, gauges, histograms, labels, missing data and aggregation before building charts.

item.description: Design useful observability dashboards with clear KPI hierarchy, chart selection, responsive layouts, accessible tooltips and visible missing-data states.

item.title: Visual testing for observability dashboards: data, layout and MCP verification
item.description: Test saved dashboards beyond JSON validation: verify queries, revisions, desktop and mobile charts, tooltip bounds and empty states.

item.title: Kubernetes health and drift answer different questions
item.description: A healthy workload can still differ from Git. Learn how to read Kubernetes health, desired-state drift and prune candidates together.

item.title: Promoting a tested Git revision across Kubernetes environments
item.description: Follow one Git revision from dev to production while keeping environment configuration, verification and release approval explicit.

item.title: Build and verify observability dashboards through MCP
item.description: Discover real providers, create reusable queries, save dashboards with exact ETags, and verify both live data and the rendered result.
